section.title: org.osgi.service.clusterinfo.dto
section.para: ClusterInfo DTO Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

section.title: public class NodeStatusDTO extends DTO
section.para: Data Transfer Object for a NodeStatus Service.

section.title: public String cluster
section.para: The name of the cluster this node belongs to.

section.title: public String country
section.para: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 location where this node instance is running, if known.

section.title: public String[] endpoints
section.para: The endpoint(s) at which this node can be accessed from the viewpoint of the consumer of the service.

section.title: public String id
section.para: The globally unique ID for this node. For example the Docker ID if this node is a Docker container, or the framework UUID if this node is an OSGi framework.

section.title: public String location
section.para: ISO 3166-2 location where this node instance is running, if known. This location is more detailed than the country code as it may contain province or territory.

section.title: public String parentid
section.para: An optional parentID indicating this node is part of or embedded in another node. For example multiple virtual machines could run on the same physical node.

section.title: public static final String PREFIX_ = "osgi.clusterinfo."
section.para: Prefix used for the converter

section.title: public String[] privateEndpoints
section.para: Private endpoint(s) at which this node can be accessed from within the cluster only.

section.title: public String region
section.para: Something smaller than a country and bigger than a location (e.g. us-east-1 or other cloud-specific location)

section.title: public String[] tags
section.para: Tags associated with this node that can be contributed to by the provider and also by bundles.

section.title: public String vendor
section.para: The vendor name of the cloud/environment in which the node operates.

section.title: public String version
section.para: The version of the cloud/environment in which the node operates. The value follows the versioning scheme of the cloud provider and may therefore not comply with the OSGi versioning syntax.

section.title: public String zone
section.para: Regions are often subdivided in zones that represent different physical locations. The zone can be provided here.

section.title: public NodeStatusDTO()
section.para: This DTO can be used to provide type safe access to properties of the NodeStatus service.
